lines.zh: 我踩着干草，爪子先落地。
lines.en: I stride over dry grass, claws first.
Head low, my neck bobs with each step.
My long tail sweeps an arc behind me.
Three-toed feet sink into soft earth.
I follow the grass line of the plains.
I lift my feet almost silently.
Step by step I press forward.
My claw tips rasp on pebbles.
The wind carries my scent away.
I pause and tilt my head to listen.
I round a low shrub.
I creep forward half crouched.

lines.zh: 我的膝弯得比看上去柔软。
lines.en: My knees bend more softly than they look.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草压成一条路。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a trail.
I turn to check where my pack is.
I quicken by half a step.
I lift a foreleg and flex my toes.
I open my jaws, teeth neatly arrayed.
I lie in the grass, chin to the ground.
My breath comes out hot.
I turn to lick my forearm.
My pack is behind and to my left.
My eyelids are half shut.
I count the sounds on the plains.
My tail tip flicks once.

lines.zh: 平原上我们一群，爪很利。
lines.en: In a pack on the plains, claws sharp.
A herd of grazers is far off.
My sickle claw stays raised.
The sun heats my back.
I wait for the wind to shift.
You stand upright, unlike prey.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的东西的气味。
lines.en: You carry another creature's scent.
My head reaches only your chest.

lines.zh: 你腰间那块铁，一直在碰。
lines.en: The iron at your waist keeps clinking.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腿，平原上跑不掉。
lines.en: I watch your legs; no escape on the plains.
You're standing in my hunting ground.
I tilt my head, one eye fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我们三个一起上，你挑谁？
lines.en: All three of us at once — pick one.
My pack is watching you too.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪微微抬起，没落下。
lines.en: My sickle claw lifts slightly, not yet falling.
My flank has been torn open.
I yelp and pull back.
Blood drips down my leg.
You hit harder than I thought.
My tail tucks in.
One leg won't take my weight.
I can still catch you.

lines.zh: 平原上一群五只，爪都张开。
lines.en: Five on the plain, all claws out.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被血粘成一撮。
lines.en: Blood mats my feathers into a clump.
I'll remember your scent.
That meat is mine.
Throw it over.
I smell blood.
That piece in your hand is small.
My pack will come too.
Set it down, then step away.
Scanty for a pack to share.
I don't eat what doesn't move.
That smells stale.
What you hold is trembling.
You hit my shoulder blade.
I twist aside, my tail sweeping past.
Don't press against my flank.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪收在脚上，没伸。
lines.en: My sickle claw stays folded, unextended.
I give half a step, claws dug in.
You're standing on my long tail.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴撑地，没被撞倒。
lines.en: I brace with my tail and stay upright.
I arch my back, a sound in my throat.
You knocked me slightly off balance.
Crowd me again and I bite.
The pack has its rules.

lines.zh: 先看你能不能跟上我们。
lines.en: First, see if you can keep up.
Such things happen on the ground.
My claws are too sharp.
You're not of our kind.
Another scent is on the wind.
We need to eat first.
Don't touch my nape.
Move along, I'm patrolling the edge.
Not now.
A piece of meat, I take it.
I sniff, then bite.
Not enough for my teeth.
I shake the bone about.
Blood on the ground, mine.
The pack will come to take it.

lines.zh: 平原上，我们三五只一起跑。
lines.en: On the plains, three or five of us run.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Your dropped things don't interest me.
One test bite, to see if it is hard.
Too hard, I spit it out.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送到我左边。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent to my left.
Close enough to spring.
Feathers low, claws hit the ground first.
My pack fans out to the side.
You've strayed too far out.
There's no cover on the plains.
My legs move first.
You turned too late.
Only a few strides needed.
Don't shout, the grass swallows it.
I lower my neck and raise my crest.
Run.
One stride covers yards.
My claws hold the ground well.
You've run into the open.
That's what I wanted.
My pack is on your right.
My tail keeps my balance.
I turn without slowing.

lines.zh: 你的脚步开始踩乱草丛。
lines.en: Your steps begin to trample the grass unevenly.
We hide in the tall grass.
You can only hear the grass.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经从右边包过去。
lines.en: My pack has already swung around your right.

lines.zh: 草原上我们三五只一队。
lines.en: Three or five of us hunt the plains.
Leap.
I spring, claws first.
My jaws clamp your calf.
My claws rip your cloth.
You flung me off.
I land and spin.
The pack lands the second blow.
My three-toed feet sink into soft earth.
I don't let go.
Blood makes them eager.

lines.zh: 我的同伴堵住了草外的空地。
lines.en: My pack blocks the open ground beyond the grass.
My teeth lodge in your leggings.
We're not full yet.
Three shapes rise in the grass.
We come from across the plains.
I lift my head first, the pack follows.
Claws score shallow grooves.
Our tails sway together.
Movement in the dawn mist.
I step out of the short grass.
This field has owners now.
I open my jaws and test my teeth.
The wind blows from behind us.

lines.zh: 我们在数这片地上的活物。
lines.en: We count the living things here.
My pack spreads into a fan.

lines.zh: 我三趾的脚先踩实了土。
lines.en: My three-toed feet plant firmly first.
This land will do for hunting.
Fire tightens the skin along my spine.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，爪子抓不住。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, claws failing.
Water pours down my throat.
The blast throws me into the grass.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder.
Magic stiffens my legs.
Long hunger drains my legs.

lines.zh: 雷落在平原上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the plain, my body jolts.
No grass to hide in, in the void.
